fact_text: The guest said Gulistan-e-Jauhar was the final scheme the Karachi Development Authority announced, and that the authority has announced no new scheme since.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: Residential plots in Gulistan-e-Jauhar are cut in 60, 80, 120, 240 and 400 gaz sizes, and the largest residential plot given in the scheme is 600 gaz.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: The Karachi Development Authority's commercial plots in the scheme include 25, 100, 120 and 400 gaz sizes, along with large FL sites given for high-rise buildings.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: The guest said the Karachi Development Authority gave more high-rise sites in Gulistan-e-Jauhar than in any other scheme, and some blocks are fully built as high-rise towers with many flats occupied.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: Early Gulistan-e-Jauhar projects were limited to ground plus four or ground plus six floors, until changed ratios and bylaws allowed high-rise construction, which the guest said started Karachi's apartment culture.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: The guest said Gulistan-e-Jauhar gives access to much of Karachi within 20 to 30 minutes with less traffic, and has Karachi University, NED University and many colleges and schools nearby.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: The guest said most buyers in Gulistan-e-Jauhar are middle and upper-middle class, and that both end-users and investors have long been drawn to the area.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: Older two-bedroom TV-lounge flats in Gulistan-e-Jauhar were quoted from about 50 to 60 lakh rupees, with some at 40 lakh and some up to 80 lakh, depending on location and building condition.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: 60 and 80 gaz plots, mostly in Block 12, were quoted at about 1 crore rupees or slightly above, with 60 and 80 gaz prices close to each other.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: 240 gaz plots, the most common size in the scheme, were quoted at about 2.5 to 3 crore rupees, with some locations above 3 crore.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: 600 gaz plots that were subdivided into 300 gaz plots are priced about the same as 240 gaz plots, according to the video.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: 600 gaz plots, mainly in Blocks 1, 14, 15 and 16, were quoted from above 5 crore rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: A 600 gaz house was quoted from about 7.5 crore rupees, rising to about 12 to 13 crore rupees.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: A three-bedroom flat of about 1,600 sq ft in a Munawwar Chowrangi project comes with a ground floor, basement, mezzanine, two parking floors, gym, mosque and driver quarters.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: Faisal Cantonment published a newspaper notice naming buildings as possibly dangerous, including some built by members of the builders' association, which wrote asking for the test parameters and had no reply by 2025-09-07.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: The guest said none of the flagged buildings is dangerous, the problems being sewerage and internal alterations, and that structural concerns can be addressed with engineering methods.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: The guest said about 30 to 40 builders, large and small, are bringing new projects to Gulistan-e-Jauhar.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: The guest argued that in real estate, title and location are the two factors that protect an investment from loss, and that Gulistan-e-Jauhar suits middle and upper-middle class buyers.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)

fact_text: The government announced a housing finance scheme in the budget with a 35 lakh rupee amount, and the builders' association is pressing to raise that amount and bring private banks into housing finance.
source_name: Nukta Business, 'Gulistan-e-Jauhar's Real Estate Investment Potential | Pakistan Property Playbook | Nukta Business' (YouTube, 2025-09-07)
